syllabus.description: Comprehensive French curriculum from absolute beginner (A1) through intermediate (B1), equivalent to approximately 4 university semesters.

A1.description: Can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases. Can introduce themselves and ask/answer personal questions.

A2.description: Can understand sentences and frequently used expressions related to immediate relevance. Can communicate in simple, routine tasks.

B1.description: Can understand main points of clear standard input on familiar matters. Can deal with most travel situations. Can produce simple connected text on familiar topics.

assessment_rubric.vocab_recall: User can translate target vocab in both directions without hints.
assessment_rubric.vocab_production: User can use target vocab correctly in self-generated sentences.
assessment_rubric.grammar_accuracy: User can produce 3+ grammatically correct sentences using the target structure without prompting.
assessment_rubric.comprehension: User can read/hear a short paragraph using lesson content and answer questions about it.
assessment_rubric.free_production: User can write a short paragraph (4-6 sentences) on the lesson topic using target vocab and grammar naturally.
assessment_rubric.mastery_note: A lesson is considered mastered when the user scores >= 0.8 across all dimensions. Lessons below 0.6 should resurface within 2 days. Lessons between 0.6-0.8 resurface within 5 days.

weeks.grammar_focus: Subject pronouns (je, tu, il/elle/on, nous, vous, ils/elles); être and s'appeler in present tense; tu vs. vous distinction
weeks.competency: User can introduce themselves, say hello/goodbye, and ask someone's name using appropriate formality.

weeks.grammar_focus: Present tense of venir, avoir; question words (où, d'où, quel âge); inversion and est-ce que question formation
weeks.competency: User can say where they are from, ask someone's age and origin, and use numbers 0-100.

weeks.grammar_focus: Possessive adjectives (mon, ma, mes, ton, ta, tes, son, sa, ses); noun gender (le, la, l', les); c'est vs. il/elle est
weeks.competency: User can describe their family members and ask about someone else's family.

vocab.term: Tu as des frères et sœurs ?

weeks.grammar_focus: Indefinite articles (un, une, des); negation with ne...pas; present tense -er verbs (travailler, parler, étudier)
weeks.competency: User can state their occupation, ask what someone does for work, and negate statements.

vocab.term: Qu'est-ce que vous faites dans la vie ?
vocab.definition: What do you do for a living?

weeks.grammar_focus: Definite articles (le, la, l', les); il y a (there is/are); Qu'est-ce que c'est?; basic adjective agreement (petit/petite)
weeks.competency: User can identify common objects, ask what something is, and use correct articles and basic adjective agreement.

weeks.grammar_focus: Time expressions (lundi, à trois heures, en janvier); present tense -ir verbs (finir, choisir); prepositions of time (à, en, de...à)
weeks.competency: User can tell time formally and informally, name days and months, and describe a simple schedule.

weeks.grammar_focus: Reflexive verbs (se lever, se coucher, se laver, s'habiller); present tense -re verbs (prendre, attendre); adverbs of frequency
weeks.competency: User can describe their daily routine from waking up to going to bed using reflexive verbs.

weeks.grammar_focus: Partitive articles (du, de la, de l', des); expressions of quantity (un peu de, beaucoup de, un kilo de); aimer, adorer, préférer, détester + infinitive/noun
weeks.competency: User can order food, express preferences, and use partitive articles correctly for food items.

weeks.grammar_focus: Demonstrative adjectives (ce, cet, cette, ces); negation variations (ne...rien, ne...jamais, ne...plus); direct object pronouns introduction (le, la, les)
weeks.competency: User can ask prices, describe what they want to buy, and handle basic shopping conversations.

weeks.grammar_focus: Review: present tense (-er, -ir, -re, irregular), articles (definite, indefinite, partitive), negation, question formation, reflexive verbs, possessives
weeks.competency: User can hold a basic conversation covering all A1 topics: introduce self, describe family/work/routine, order food, shop, and tell time.

vocab.definition: How do you say... in French?

weeks.grammar_focus: Prepositions of place (dans, sur, sous, devant, derrière, entre, à côté de); il y a vs. c'est; adjective placement (before vs. after noun)
weeks.competency: User can describe their home, name rooms and furniture, and say where things are located.

weeks.grammar_focus: Imperative mood (tu, nous, vous forms); aller + à/au/aux/en; prepositions with places (à, en, au, aux for countries/cities)
weeks.competency: User can ask for and give directions, understand simple navigation instructions, and use correct prepositions for locations.

weeks.grammar_focus: Near future (aller + infinitive); venir de + infinitive (recent past); modal-like constructions (devoir, pouvoir, vouloir, savoir)
weeks.competency: User can discuss travel plans, buy tickets, and express ability/necessity/desire around transportation.

weeks.grammar_focus: Impersonal il fait constructions (il fait beau, il fait froid); si-clauses introduction (present + present/future); adverbs formation (-ment)
weeks.competency: User can describe the weather, talk about seasons, and form simple conditional sentences about weather plans.

weeks.grammar_focus: Adjective agreement and placement deepened (beau/bel/belle, nouveau/nouvel/nouvelle, vieux/vieil/vieille); plaire à; colors
weeks.competency: User can describe what people are wearing, express opinions on appearance, and use irregular adjectives correctly.

weeks.grammar_focus: Avoir mal à + body part; indirect object pronouns (me, te, lui, nous, vous, leur); imperative with pronouns
weeks.competency: User can describe symptoms, name body parts, and communicate at a doctor's office or pharmacy.

weeks.grammar_focus: Faire + activity (faire du sport, faire de la natation); jouer à vs. jouer de; stress pronouns (moi, toi, lui, elle, etc.)
weeks.competency: User can discuss hobbies, express likes and dislikes, and invite someone to do something.

weeks.grammar_focus: Future simple (je parlerai, tu finiras); temporal prepositions (avant, après, depuis, pendant, jusqu'à); en + present participle (gérondif introduction)
weeks.competency: User can make appointments, suggest times, accept/decline invitations, and discuss future plans.

vocab.definition: I can't wait / I'm looking forward to it

weeks.grammar_focus: Conditional present for politeness (je voudrais, pourriez-vous); indirect questions (Pouvez-vous me dire où...?); y and en pronouns
weeks.competency: User can navigate a full restaurant experience: reserve a table, order, ask about dishes, handle the bill.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passé composé with avoir (regular: parlé, fini, vendu; irregular: fait, bu, vu, lu, écrit); past participle formation rules
weeks.competency: User can describe past events and activities using passé composé with avoir, including common irregular participles.

weeks.topic: Past Tense: Passé Composé (Part 2) & Imparfait Introduction
weeks.grammar_focus: Passé composé with être (allé, venu, parti, né, mort + DR MRS VANDERTRAMP); agreement of past participle with être; imparfait formation and basic usage (descriptions, habits)
weeks.competency: User can narrate past events using passé composé with être and avoir, and begin using imparfait for descriptions.

weeks.grammar_focus: Review: prepositions of place, pronouns (direct, indirect, y, en), imperative, near future, future simple, passé composé, imparfait introduction, conditional for politeness
weeks.competency: User can handle everyday situations (housing, health, travel, restaurants), narrate past events, and express opinions with reasons.

vocab.definition: on one hand... on the other hand

weeks.grammar_focus: Subordinate clauses with que, qui, où; relative pronouns (qui, que, dont, où); indirect speech with present reporting verb
weeks.competency: User can discuss their educational background, describe courses, and report what others said.

weeks.grammar_focus: Relative pronouns deepened (dont, lequel, auquel, duquel); possessive pronouns (le mien, la tienne); compound tenses review
weeks.competency: User can describe their work environment, discuss tasks and responsibilities, and use relative pronouns fluently.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passive voice (être + past participle); on as passive substitute; verbs with à and de (commencer à, finir de, réussir à)
weeks.competency: User can discuss technology, describe processes using passive voice, and talk about media consumption.

weeks.grammar_focus: Subjunctive mood introduction (il faut que, je veux que, pour que + subjunctive); subjunctive of être, avoir, aller, faire, pouvoir
weeks.competency: User can express emotions, describe feelings, and use the subjunctive for necessity, desire, and purpose.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passé composé vs. imparfait mastery (actions vs. descriptions/habits); plus-que-parfait; temporal conjunctions (quand, lorsque, pendant que, après que, avant que + subjunctive)
weeks.competency: User can narrate a sequence of past events distinguishing completed actions from background descriptions.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passive voice deepened (past, future passive); cause and consequence expressions (grâce à, à cause de, c'est pourquoi); infinitive constructions (avant de, après avoir/être + past participle)
weeks.competency: User can discuss environmental topics, describe nature, and express opinions about ecological issues.

vocab.term: le changement climatique / le réchauffement climatique

weeks.grammar_focus: Relative clauses with prepositions (la ville dans laquelle...); demonstrative pronouns (celui, celle, ceux, celles); mise en relief (c'est...qui/que)
weeks.competency: User can discuss cultural practices, describe holidays and traditions, and use complex relative structures.

weeks.grammar_focus: Conditional deepened (si + imparfait → conditionnel présent); comparisons (plus...que, moins...que, aussi...que, meilleur/mieux)
weeks.competency: User can book accommodation, describe travel experiences, make comparisons, and discuss hypothetical travel plans.

vocab.definition: I would like to travel to...

weeks.grammar_focus: Verbs with fixed prepositions deepened (s'occuper de, dépendre de, insister sur); pronoun en and y mastery; faire causatif (faire + infinitive)
weeks.competency: User can handle banking interactions, discuss financial matters, navigate basic French bureaucracy.

weeks.grammar_focus: Subjunctive deepened (expressions of doubt, emotion, judgment: je doute que, il est important que); passive with modal constructions; complex connectors (non seulement...mais aussi, ni...ni)
weeks.competency: User can understand and discuss news articles, report what others said, and express nuanced opinions.

weeks.grammar_focus: Pour + infinitive (purpose); au lieu de + infinitive; sans + infinitive; faire faire (causative deepened)
weeks.competency: User can discuss health goals, describe wellness routines, give and receive health advice.

weeks.grammar_focus: Concessive expressions (bien que + subjunctive, malgré + noun, pourtant, cependant); conditional for advice (À ta place, je ferais...); argumentation structures
weeks.competency: User can express and defend opinions, make concessions, give advice, and engage in structured debate.

vocab.definition: In your place, I would do...

weeks.grammar_focus: Review of future simple and conditional; si-clauses all types (present/future, imparfait/conditional); temporal clauses with dès que, aussitôt que, tant que
weeks.competency: User can discuss future plans and aspirations, describe hypothetical scenarios, and write about personal goals.

weeks.grammar_focus: Comprehensive review: all tenses (present, passé composé, imparfait, plus-que-parfait, future, conditional), subjunctive, passive, relative clauses, all pronouns, si-clauses
weeks.competency: User can participate in extended conversation on familiar topics, narrate experiences, express and justify opinions, and handle most everyday situations in a French-speaking country.

vocab.term: C'est en forgeant qu'on devient forgeron
Je suis fier/fière de mes progrès
vocab.definition: I am proud of my progress
